LESSON: TAWAKKUL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Tawakkul

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Tawakkul. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life
3. appreciate the virtue of tawakkul as a condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: TAWAKKUL
This lesson teaches Tawakkul for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the virtue of tawakkul as a condition for success in this life and the Hereafter
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Tawakkul using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Tawakkul above.
2. Explain Tawakkul to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Tawakkul.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Tawakkul with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Tawakkul important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah?
2. Why is tawakkul important to a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life
3. appreciate the virtue of tawakkul as a condition for success in this life and the Hereafter
